about_the_game:
Cola Tycoon begins in 1865, at the tipping point of history. The old world is dying. The slow-dripped wine, the aged whisky—dusty traditions of a fading elite. Now, the people crave for speed.

In this 19th-century tycoon game, you rise as an inventor with a vision. Build factories, hire specialists to generate production, marketing, and innovation, and craft your own Cola formulas through research and experimentation.

Invest, expand, and design targeted campaigns to capture new audiences and fuel your growing empire. The aristocrats had their time. You have ambition—and bubbles.

Create your own cola formula by combining ingredients. You spend Innovation Points to unlock and research new ingredients. Once unlocked, ingredients can be added to your formula. Each formula affects consumer response. You can iterate and improve formulas over time based on market performance.

Production starts by building factories. Each factory requires Factory Points to operate and scale. You can increase output by either hiring more workers or upgrading efficiency for that specific factory and region. Demand varies by region, and you must balance production to meet it. Overproduction leads to wasted resources, while underproduction results in missed profit opportunities.

In the marketing system, you use Marketing Points to create campaigns targeted at specific audiences. Each campaign consists of a selected target group, a marketing type, and an optional icon that boosts campaign performance.

Each new region has its own requirements, consumer preferences, and wealth levels. To expand into a region, you must spend money to unlock it. Once unlocked, you can build factories, launch marketing campaigns, and introduce your formulas to the market. Regions operate independently, requiring separate management of production and marketing. Expansion increases your overall reach and demand potential.

Conquer hearts and stomachs with your bubbling empire—one bottle at a time. Outpace tradition, outsmart rivals, and sweeten the world into submission. This isn’t just business—it’s a revolution in a glass.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Hardware Accelerated Graphics with dedicated memory
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • Additional Notes: Supports every resolution.

short_description: Cola Tycoon is an economic sandbox in which you invent iconic cola recipes, build industrial-era factories, and launch marketing campaigns to dominate the 19th-century drink market. Experiment with formulas, adapt to market shifts, and shape the industry one bottle at a time.
